description: This file defines the 'issueTrackerCommands' class, which manages issue tracker operations such as create, update, delete, and connection checks within the TestLink project. It handles GUI initialization, user permissions, and interactions with issue tracker implementations.

classes.name: issueTrackerCommands
classes.description: A class providing command operations for issue trackers, including creation, editing, deletion, and connection testing, with GUI support and permission management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing database handler, issue tracker manager, and access control list.

methods.name: setTemplateCfg
methods.description: Sets the template configuration for GUI rendering.

methods.name: getGuiOpWhiteList
methods.description: Returns the whitelist of allowed GUI operations.

methods.name: initGuiBean
methods.description: Initializes GUI data object with labels, permissions, and action-specific descriptions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Prepares GUI object for creating a new issue tracker.

methods.name: doCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a new issue tracker, saving data and updating GUI accordingly.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares GUI object for editing an existing issue tracker.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Processes updates to an existing issue tracker and updates GUI.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Deletes an issue tracker and updates GUI feedback.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Checks connectivity to the specified issue tracker and updates GUI status.
